api.note: API v1 alone does not establish review-v2 or private Web auth-status capability.

features.note: Both features are additive on review-v2 only. dense-128 raises the finding page from 32 to 128 and stays bounded by the 64 KiB body ceiling Core 0.10.0 serves, and reason-v1 adds a reason to each not_evaluated finding. A request without the header answers the published 32-finding, seven-key document; a header on review-v1, an unknown or repeated token, or an empty part is invalid_request, and a response that enabled a feature echoes the accepted set in the same header.

manuscript.note: v1 and v2 keep their meaning, and an imported v1 or v2 report, a document-mode choice or a semantic decision stays history, not a fresh check. v3 adds per-segment term results for long manuscripts: a saved segment result is reused only when its content hashes, review basis and request inputs all match a live review-v2 basis. v4 keeps v3's 13 top-level keys, the 44 MiB file limit and the canonical bytes, and raises the findings, resolutions and choices limits from 32 to 128 while allowing a reason on a not_evaluated finding; only the label v4 brings those limits, so a v1, v2 or v3 file keeps its 32-item caps and rejects reason. A writer stores the lowest format that holds the content (v1/v2, then v3, then v4). The v4 contract ships in Web 0.4.0, 0.4.1 and 0.4.2 and in Windows 0.6.0, 0.6.1 and 0.6.2, not in Web 0.3.1 or Windows 0.5.1, which reject a v4 file; the shipped-release records below keep the format each release was recorded with.

terms_database.note: Build or obtain the terms database separately; it is not included in the products.

telegram_state.chat_settings: Unversioned JSON with public and allowed fields.

release.note: v0.12.0 is a runtime-architecture, execution-budget, timeout-hardening and observability release on top of v0.11.0 (#308, #309, #310, #311). wuwaterm.translation_plan introduces TranslationPlan, RequestPolicy, ProviderProfile, TranslationRequestSpec, RequestIdentity and OperationIdentity shared with offline evaluation scripts (FINGERPRINT_VERSION = 4), and removes all eight legacy src/wuwaterm mypy ignore_errors overrides while extending scripts/validate.py mypy checks to src/wuwaterm_api (#308). OperationIdentity establishes single-segment request, RequestPolicy, ProviderProfile, dictionary, matcher, postprocess and corrective-prompt identity and does not encode outer OperationExecutionBudget caps (max_total_calls, max_corrective_calls, max_corrective_calls_per_segment, timeout_seconds, cooperative cancellation) or multi-segment/channel envelopes (#311). OperationExecutionBudget enforces bounded upstream calls across translate_request_async (at most 2 calls and 1 shared corrective slot across HTML-to-plain fallback, timeout fallback and paragraph repair), long split texts, channel_post_handler aligned with ChannelRuntime.reserve, semantic_review_async and llm_transport.post_chat_completion (MY-483, #309). Pure ASGI TimeoutMiddleware adds an explicit anyio.CancelScope and _abort_if_request_deadline_expired guard so expired deadlines return HTTP 504 (internal / request exceeded the server time budget, logged as request timed out) instead of 503 (#309). Bounded RequestTrace and RuntimeMetrics add strategy/fallback/budget counters and scripts/summarize_runtime_metrics.py aggregates logs without free text (#309). Stdlib-only wuwaterm.text_spans (WHITESPACE, paragraph_ranges, segment_core, sentence_ranges, sentence_ranges_v2, review_sentence_ranges_v2) decouples segmentation, translation_plan and sentence from review and SQLite and tightens Rule #11 (#310). Dictionary builder logic, SQLite schema 2, wuwaterm-cjk-matcher-v9, data pin 9218d612 (3.7.0 / 3.7.8 / 8975829), OpenAPI/HTTP contracts (except info.version 0.12.0), en->zh omit default and zh->en disabled default are unchanged from v0.11.0, so v0.11.0 hosts can upgrade with --runtime-only. previous_release.note: v0.11.0 is a dictionary and translation release on top of v0.10.3. The CJK matcher moves to wuwaterm-cjk-matcher-v9 (#300): a single-character CJK name is admitted only at a plausible right boundary, 有 joins the particle set so 椿有极其优秀的 is admitted while everyday 心 and ordinary compounds stay out, and translation reference admission and review-v2 consult the same helper, so stored v8 resolution contexts go stale and are re-reviewed. The pinned 3.7 data yields eight official dictionary rows it did not have before: the seven remaining multi-character Advertising_VersionTitle_30 to _36 release titles (37 was already curated), which runtime treats as contextual references on both sides and never as a forced substitution, and the derived item base 调谐器 / Tuner beside the speaker 调音师 / Tuner; because those are rows in the shipped dictionary, this release needs a full build-db rebuild, and a runtime-only update keeps the old database and changes none of it. Reference admission is occurrence-scoped (#300): retained pre-exclusion casefold collisions stay as model candidates, derived references (Area_<n>_Title, tier-base:<id>, soft-casing hints) are gated on natural-paragraph official term context, an admitted reference carries fail-closed model_start/model_end coordinates, and plain single-meaning requests keep byte-identical prompts. On zh->en a mixed single-character CJK proper name is locked selectively, so a character a longer global term already translates stays a scoped reference instead of reaching the prompt twice, and a surface that arrives as both a (speaker) entry and another kind of entry gets one disambiguating sentence, which fixes ordinary-en-zh reading the Tuner as 调音师; zh->en context requests ask for numeric qualifiers and trailing ellipses to survive translation, and the en->zh prompt is byte-identical (#300). WUWATERM_TRANSLATION_THINKING_EN_ZH gains an opt-in auto that resolves the mode per request: disabled at 4 or more locks or 25 or more paragraphs and low otherwise, one paragraph-count repair on a context-mode answer whose paragraph count differs from its source, and one shorter retry with thinking off after an auto timeout (#300). The production en->zh default stays omit and zh->en stays disabled (#302), so an unconfigured deployment sends the byte-identical provider-default request it sent before the setting existed; auto is a complete, tested opt-in, only auto may pick a different mode for a repair, and =omit remains the documented rollback. A segment now has at most one corrective call, so at most two model calls (#302): the low to disabled fallback under auto spends that call, a segment whose first attempt needed no fallback still gets its one repair, and an explicit mode still shores up its own request. Measured with auto explicitly opted in (WUWATERM_TRANSLATION_THINKING_EN_ZH=auto, q8r1 on c1bab1aa, 545 to 568 of 569, 23 POSTs, doubled-blind scoring at 95.9% judge agreement and 0/71 identical-output drift), D en-zh usable went 65/101 to 93/101 with 0 timeouts, D-009 went 0/30 usable to 28/30 at 3.7 s, the paired 65/71 usable with 6 critical errors held, D zh-en usable went 126/131 to 128/131, ordinary reached 12/12, and the 17-document D en-zh runtime went 221.4 s to 147.7 s; none of the en-zh numbers was measured under the shipped omit default, so they describe the opt-in and not an unconfigured deployment, and subsequent full R verification (#307) on 074f3cb7 passed 34/34 (M-Gold 667/675, Set 1 119/124, Set 2 38/39). The model timeout (45 s), the request budget (90 s), segmentation-v1 (L = 1800), the OpenAPI and HTTP contracts and the product contracts are unchanged, the data pin stays 9218d612 (3.7.0 / 3.7.8 / 8975829), the Web and Windows pins stay at v0.10.3's, and H2 stays held-out used. On source_commit 074f3cb7, ci.yml main push run 45120274598, CodeQL run 45120274190, Dependency audit run 45120274243, release.yml (dry_run=false) run 45121590479 and the release-triggered run 45121891441 all succeeded.
